title: IP Glucose Tolerance Test in Mouse
author: Nancy Smith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wxhffj6
materials: STELLUX Chemi Rodent Insulin ELISA kit

steps.title: Fast mice before test
steps.instruction: Begin fasting at ~09:00 am; keep mice in clean cages with wire tops and water bottles for 4–6 hours before the IPGTT. If mice are on a high‑fat diet (HFD), set aside their food to return after the test and mark tails with a Sharpie for identification.

steps.title: Weigh mouse and calculate dose
steps.instruction: Weigh each mouse to obtain body weight (g). Calculate the glucose bolus: for standard diet use 1 g kg⁻¹ (volume = weight (g) × 2 µL of 50 % dextrose); for HFD ≥4 weeks use 0.5 g kg⁻¹ (volume = weight (g) × 1 µL of 50 % dextrose). Record the calculation in the GTT‑template spreadsheet.xlsx.

substeps.instruction: Apply appropriate formula (1 g kg⁻¹ or 0.5 g kg⁻¹).
Note calculated µL of sterile 50 % dextrose.

steps.title: Prepare syringes with glucose
steps.instruction: Using a 1 mL (1 cc) syringe fitted with a 26 G needle, draw the calculated volume of sterile 50 % dextrose solution, load each syringe, and place them in front of the home cage for quick access.

steps.title: Measure baseline blood glucose
steps.instruction: Restrain the mouse, clean the tail with 70 % ethanol and gauze, then obtain a small blood drop from the tail vein onto a One Touch Ultra blood glucose strip and read the value with a One Touch Ultra 2 meter (time = 0 min).

steps.title: Collect baseline plasma (optional)
steps.instruction: If plasma insulin will be measured, collect the same tail‑vein blood into a microvette tube (capillary‑type). Tap the tube until all blood enters, then place the tube on ice until plasma processing.

steps.title: Inject glucose intraperitoneally
steps.instruction: Restrain the mouse, place it in dorsal recumbency with head down, locate the bend of the knee and ventral abdominal midline, insert the needle halfway between midline and lateral side at the natural knee bend, at a 30–45° angle into the left or right lower abdominal quadrant. Aspirate to confirm no blood, intestinal, or bladder entry (air bubble only). Inject the calculated glucose dose and return the mouse to its cage.

steps.title: Start post‑injection timer
steps.instruction: Begin timing from the moment the sterile 50 % dextrose solution is successfully delivered (time = 0 min).

steps.title: Collect blood glucose over time
steps.instruction: At 15, 30, 60, 90, and 120 minutes after injection, restrain the mouse, clean the tail, obtain a blood drop onto a One Touch Ultra strip, and record the glucose value on the Glucose Tolerance Test record sheet (template from step 2). Also record animal condition throughout.

substeps.instruction: Collect blood for glucose at 15 min.
Collect blood for glucose at 30 min.
Collect blood for glucose at 60 min.
Collect blood for glucose at 90 min (no plasma collection).
Collect blood for glucose at 120 min.

steps.title: Collect plasma samples
steps.instruction: At 15, 30, 60, and 120 minutes (skip 90 min) collect additional tail‑vein blood into microvette tubes for plasma, ensuring total blood drawn does not exceed 0.007 mL per gram body weight.

steps.title: Return food and enrichment
steps.instruction: After the experiment, place saved HFD food (if used) and any environmental enrichment back into the cages.

steps.title: First centrifugation of plasma tubes
steps.instruction: Place microvette tubes in a pre‑chilled centrifuge and spin for 2 minutes at 2000 rpm at 4 °C.

steps.title: Seal and dispose microvette caps
steps.instruction: Remove the capillary‑lid from each tube and discard it in a biohazard bin; then replace the base lid, click‑seal the microvette.

steps.title: Second centrifugation for plasma
steps.instruction: Re‑centrifuge the sealed microvette tubes for 10 minutes at 10 000 rpm at 4 °C.

steps.title: Transfer and store plasma
steps.instruction: Using a pipette, transfer the clear plasma layer to a clean, labeled tube and store the plasma at –20 °C until analysis.

steps.title: Assay insulin by ELISA
steps.instruction: Measure plasma insulin with the STELLUX Chemi Rodent Insulin ELISA kit (ALPCO) following the manufacturer’s protocol (see https://s3.amazonaws.com/alpco-docs/80/80-INSMR-CH01.pdf).
